headline: Bitcoin Miner PowerCompute Liquidates 267 BTC to Pay $22M Debt, Retains Warning
summary: Bitcoin miner PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September to eliminate $22 million in debt, ending the month with $650,000 in cash and an active going-concern warning.
why: Rising network difficulty and power costs have strained smaller cryptocurrency miners, prompting asset liquidations to satisfy debt obligations.

impacts.name: PowerCompute
impacts.why: The miner exhausted most cash and issued a going-concern warning after debt liquidation.
